<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
	<h:head>
		<h:title>Close household</h:title>
		<model>
			<instance>
				<data xmlns:jrm="http://dev.commcarehq.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://openrosa.org/formdesigner/3145464F-720F-59EB-AB97-DBF59E97A59F" uiVersion="1" version="1" name="Close household">
					<nova_operations>
						<nova_condition_close>
							<nova_close vellum:case_type="household" vellum:role="SaveToCase">
								<case xmlns="http://commcarehq.org/case/transaction/v2" case_id="" date_modified="" user_id="">
									<close />
								</case>
							</nova_close>
						</nova_condition_close>
					</nova_operations>
					<reason />
					<confirm />
				</data>
			</instance>
			<instance src="jr://instance/session" id="commcaresession" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/nova_operations" nodeset="/data/nova_operations" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/nova_operations/nova_condition_close" nodeset="/data/nova_operations/nova_condition_close" vellum:relevant="#form/reason = #form/confirm" relevant="/data/reason = /data/confirm" />
			<bind nodeset="/data/nova_operations/nova_condition_close/nova_close/case/close" />
			<bind nodeset="/data/nova_operations/nova_condition_close/nova_close/case/@date_modified" calculate="/data/meta/timeEnd" type="xsd:dateTime" />
			<bind nodeset="/data/nova_operations/nova_condition_close/nova_close/case/@user_id" calculate="/data/meta/userID" />
			<bind nodeset="/data/nova_operations/nova_condition_close/nova_close/case/@case_id" calculate="instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/reason" nodeset="/data/reason" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/confirm" nodeset="/data/confirm" type="xsd:string" />
			<itext>
				<translation lang="en" default="">
					<text id="reason-label">
						<value>Reason</value>
						<value form="markdown">Reason</value>
					</text>
					<text id="confirm-label">
						<value>Confirm the reason</value>
						<value form="markdown">Confirm the reason</value>
					</text>
				</translation>
			</itext>
		</model>
	</h:head>
	<h:body>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/nova_operations" ref="/data/nova_operations">
			<group vellum:ref="#form/nova_operations/nova_condition_close" ref="/data/nova_operations/nova_condition_close" />
		</group>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/reason" ref="/data/reason">
			<label ref="jr:itext('reason-label')" />
		</input>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/confirm" ref="/data/confirm">
			<label ref="jr:itext('confirm-label')" />
		</input>
	</h:body>
</h:html>

<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
	<h:head>

					<seen />
					<nova_selected_cases ids="" count="" current_index="" vellum:role="Repeat">
						<item id="" index="" jr:template="">
							<nova_operations>
								<mark_each vellum:case_type="household" vellum:role="SaveToCase">
									<case xmlns="http://commcarehq.org/case/transaction/v2" case_id="" date_modified="" user_id="">
										<update>
											<last_seen />
										</update>
									</case>
								</mark_each>
							</nova_operations>
						</item>
					</nova_selected_cases>
				</data>
			</instance>
			<instance src="jr://instance/selected-entities/selected_cases" id="selected_cases" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seen" nodeset="/data/seen" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind nodeset="/data/nova_selected_cases/@current_index" vellum:calculate="count(#form/nova_selected_cases/item)" calculate="count(/data/nova_selected_cases/item)" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/nova_selected_cases/item" nodeset="/data/nova_selected_cases/item" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/nova_selected_cases/item/nova_operations" nodeset="/data/nova_selected_cases/item/nova_operations" />
			<bind nodeset="/data/nova_selected_cases/item/nova_operations/mark_each/case/update/last_seen" vellum:calculate="#form/seen" calculate="/data/seen" />
			<bind nodeset="/data/nova_selected_cases/item/nova_operations/mark_each/case/@date_modified" calculate="/data/meta/timeEnd" type="xsd:dateTime" />
			<bind nodeset="/data/nova_selected_cases/item/nova_operations/mark_each/case/@user_id" calculate="/data/meta/userID" />
			<bind nodeset="/data/nova_selected_cases/item/nova_operations/mark_each/case/@case_id" calculate="current()/../../../../@id" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" ref="/data/nova_selected_cases/@ids" value="join(' ', if(count(instance('selected_cases')/results/value) > 0, instance('selected_cases')/results/value, ''))" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" ref="/data/nova_selected_cases/@count" value="count-selected(/data/nova_selected_cases/@ids)" />
			<setvalue event="jr-insert" ref="/data/nova_selected_cases/item/@index" value="int(/data/nova_selected_cases/@current_index)" />
			<setvalue event="jr-insert" ref="/data/nova_selected_cases/item/@id" value="selected-at(/data/nova_selected_cases/@ids, ../@index)" />
			<itext>
				<translation lang="en" default="">
					<text id="seen-label">
						<value>Seen on</value>
						<value form="markdown">Seen on</value>
					</text>
				</translation>
			</itext>
		</model>
	</h:head>
	<h:body>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/seen" ref="/data/seen">
			<label ref="jr:itext('seen-label')" />
		</input>
		<group>
			<repeat jr:count="/data/nova_selected_cases/@count" jr:noAddRemove="true()" vellum:nodeset="#form/nova_selected_cases/item" nodeset="/data/nova_selected_cases/item">
				<group vellum:ref="#form/nova_selected_cases/item/nova_operations" ref="/data/nova_selected_cases/item/nova_operations" />
			</repeat>
		</group>
	</h:body>
</h:html>
